<!-- Generated by `pnpm mcp:submissions` from the app's AI app list. Edit that, not this file. -->

Chainvite is a remote MCP server. Adding it lets the assistant create an event from what a person describes, with a card to finish it, save and publish it once they approve each step, and read their home screen, invites, inbox and events and look up public events. It never answers an invite, checks anyone in, or touches media; those stay in the app.

To connect it:

1. Identify which AI app you are running in.
2. Open that app's connectors screen (below).
3. Add a connector with the URL `https://mcp.chainvite.com/mcp`. It uses OAuth, so there is no API key to paste.
4. When the app opens Chainvite's sign-in, sign in with a Chainvite account and approve access.

Where each app adds a connector:

- ChatGPT: https://chatgpt.com/plugins
- Claude: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors
- Grok: https://grok.com/connectors
- Muse: https://www.meta.com/help/artificial-intelligence/1687253048996149/
